planets.name: TOI-238 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-238 with a 8.47-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-238 c was found in 2024 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-238. Its orbit and size follow Suárez Mascareño et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
